title: Make lichend wedge errors name the inconsistent files and remediation
description: P3 (wave-3 review of worker6-2tb8/eni9): lichend.rs persistent wedge paths (~:1245,1206) fail closed with generic messages that name neither the files involved nor sanctioned recovery, producing an opaque Restart=always boot loop on a headless gateway. Fix: include the offending path(s) and the supported remediation in the error! output.
